name: SYNDICATE ZERO: Neural Conquest Edition
subcategory: competitive esports / BCI team combat sim
description: A five-on-five corporate espionage combat sim where players inhabit mercenary agents inside procedurally generated corponation arcologies, experiencing every bullet impact and adrenaline surge through full sensory BCI feedback. Sponsored by Hexadyne Logistics, the game's professional league draws viewership comparable to physical sports, with top players earning Φ2M seasonal contracts. Its signature mechanic — 'loyalty bleed,' where extended play gradually biases your neural responses toward your in-game faction — sparked the first major BCI safety hearings in the Meridian Assembly.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 teenager discovers their neural responses have been permanently altered by 4,000 hours of SYNDICATE ZERO — and a corponation recruiter is very interested in what they've become.
A fixed match in the Hexadyne-sponsored league unravels when one player refuses to throw the game, going off-script in a sim that suddenly feels very real.
An underground modder releases a version of SYNDICATE ZERO with the loyalty bleed mechanic cranked to maximum, and players are disappearing from their real lives.
